target_description: Target variable (1 - client with payment difficulties: he/she had late payment more than X days on at least one of the first Y installments of the loan in our sample, 0 - all other cases)
cutoff: Relative day 0 (current application); bureau credit and update <=0; previous decision <=0; installment due and payment <=0. Missing dates excluded. Historical tables remain retrospective snapshots; exact field availability is not proven.
validation: Stratified independent customers, not temporal: no global application calendar available.
